patterns.note: Full-width content sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring large background imagery or solid color blocks to segment information.
Prominent, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is used for main headings and calls to action, creating a strong, energetic visual hierarchy.
A vibrant and energetic color palette combines deep blues and crisp whites with bright accent colors like teal, red, and yellow, particularly for product highlights and calls to action.

The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background as it detaches from the hero section, while a top promotional banner remains sticky at the very top of the viewport. A floating circular search button also remains fixed on the right side of the screen.
Product display sections utilize a tabbed navigation system to filter product categories, presenting items in a responsive grid layout with clear pricing and 'Add to Cart' buttons.

technique_notes: The hero section is implemented as a full-bleed carousel, likely using the detected Swiper library, allowing for multiple promotional slides with large imagery and overlaid text. Content within the hero scrolls up with the page.

The main header employs a sticky transformation effect: initially transparent and integrated with the hero, it transitions to a condensed, solid white bar with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections below the hero appear to slide or fade up into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal experience as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong impact, complemented by clear, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to buttons, product cards, and input fields, providing a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with airy sections for the hero and impact statements, and a more compact but clear grid for product displays.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and playful integration of a major brand collaboration (Spider-Man) directly into the hero and product imagery, creating an energetic and distinctive visual narrative that feels less like a generic e-commerce site and more like a themed experience. The use of vibrant, almost comic-book-style typography and color accents reinforces this unique brand personality.
